name: Akash Sourav
role: Deputy Vice President – Engineering (managed Aditya at CollegeSearch)
text:
I had the privilege of managing Aditya during his time as a Software Engineer at Collegesearch.
From the very beginning, he demonstrated exceptional technical acumen, a strong work ethic, and a genuine passion for building high-quality, scalable solutions.

What stood out most about Aditya was his ability to take ownership of complex challenges and deliver reliable results under tight timelines. He brought a calm, thoughtful approach to every project — combining precision with creativity.

Beyond his technical skills, Aditya was an excellent team player, always open to feedback and proactive in helping peers. His professionalism and curiosity made him a valuable contributor to our team culture.

I’m confident that Aditya will continue to excel and make a significant impact in any organization he joins.

Highly recommended.

name: Aarush Mishra
role: Senior PM, Ex-Founder (managed Aditya at CollegeSearch)
text:
It was genuinely fun working with Aditya. He joined CollegeSearch while still in college, full of curiosity, energy, and a constant stream of questions: some deeply relevant, others completely out-of-the-box, but always driven by a desire to learn and improve.

What I really appreciated about him was his attitude toward problem-solving. Give him a challenging brief and he’d worry (a lot at first!), but that worry always turned into focus, research, and persistence until he delivered. Over time, we realized that his overthinking wasn’t a flaw, it was his way of caring deeply about doing things right.

Aditya brought fresh ideas, innovative perspectives, and a contagious enthusiasm to every discussion. With the right guidance, he’s a compact powerhouse someone who consistently delivers impact beyond expectations.

Will definitely like to cross paths again may be with experienced Aditya!
